cds.title: Penn State Behrend Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set, Penn State Behrend campus only, fall 2025 entering class (residency split as printed; totals check: in-state + out-of-state + international = total). No early decision; early action closes 11/01 with notification 12/24; no application closing date, rolling. Enrollment: 3,211 undergraduates, 150 nonresident undergraduates. International first-years: 755 applied, 685 admitted (91%), 48 enrolled. SAT/ACT optional (considered if submitted); score percentiles are for the 209 enrolled SAT submitters (ACT: 22 students). The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column.

cds_test_policy.notes: Common Data Set: SAT/ACT not required for admission, but considered if submitted.

cost.notes: First-year costs from the Common Data Set (2026-27), Penn State Behrend campus: tuition in-state $15,388, out-of-state/nonresident $26,904 (international students pay the nonresident rate); required fees $630; food and housing $15,864 (housing $9,822 + food $6,042); books $1,290; other costs = transportation $2,244 + other expenses $3,112. Tuition varies by program. The college's own scholarship and grant aid is not available to nonresident undergraduates
